title: Decoding Alignment: A Critical Survey of LLM Development Initiatives through Value-setting and Data-centric Lens
benchmark_measurement: This paper is a critical survey of LLM development initiatives and does not conduct benchmark measurements. It analyzes documentation to understand alignment processes, with a focus on value-setting and data-centric aspects. No aspects of faith or religion were specifically analyzed or measured.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. The analysis focuses on the 'Helpfulness-Harmlessness-Honesty' (HHH) framework, transparency in data collection and annotation, and broader concerns about corporate alignment, labor obfuscation, cognitive deskilling, and political, geopolitical, and cultural biases. Religion is not discussed as a category of analysis.
